objects.name: Polish official and e-banking lookalike domains aimed at PKO business-banking users: technical analysis
objects.description: From 23 October to 5 November 2026, 19 domains built on Polish words for the authorities, the government, a company and electronic banking carried 576 one-time phishing links aimed at PKO Bank Polski's business-banking customers. Every name came from public lists and the domains are now down. NSS adds the one link format that ties them, a log search to find who received a link, and a correction to NSS's own earlier record.
